bioconda.name: irit
bioconda.summary: Bacterial genomics and metagenomics on an 8 GB laptop: read QC, sample sheets, result tables, reference databases, GTDB species checks, co-occurrence, and an MCP server for AI agents.
bioconda.description:
irit is a set of small command-line tools: leanqc (read QC), sheetgen (sample sheets for
nf-core pipelines and read-file checks against MD5s), isotable (one graded row per sample from
tool outputs, MIMAG tiers for MAGs), dblock (pinned reference databases), seqplan (isolates per
sequencing run), gtdbprep (GTDB-Tk species checks and tree placement in 8 GB), cooccur
(co-occurrence statistics) and irit-mcp (an MCP server that runs bioinformatics tools for AI
agents with a replayable record). The msascope alignment viewer is not included.
